{"command": "python3 -c "
import json
m = json.load(open('/work/map.json'))
print('=== FINAL MAP VERIFIED ===')
print('frame:', m['frame'])
print('units:', m['units'])
print('stop_reason:', m['stop_reason'])
print('object count:', len(m['objects']))
print()
for o in m['objects']:
    evs = ', '.join(e['frame_id'] for e in o['evidence'])
    print(f\"  {o['id']:<14} {o['category']:<14} x={o['x']:<5} y={o['y']:<5} conf={o['confidence']}  [{evs}]\")
print()
print('Map complete at checkpoint 20.')
"", "description": "Final verification of map.json"}
